slides.title: 5 signs you haven't actually rested in months

slides.heading: your "break" is _another screen_
slides.top: work on the laptop, rest on _the phone_
slides.text:
your eyes haven't had a day off

_in months_

slides.heading: you can't sit still _without reaching for it_
you lie down and your brain _keeps scrolling_
slides.top: phone off, but the feed _keeps playing_ in your head

slides.heading: a whole weekend and you're _still drained_
slides.text:
doing nothing on your phone

isn't _doing nothing_

slides.heading: rest has to _start at night_
slides.top: the last hour before bed _decides the next day_
slides.text:
so my apps _switch off at bedtime_ now

and i finally wake up _feeling like i slept_
